warn: sd-https-tls/set-7: The solution says, "The ClientHello carries at most the site's name." ClientHello also carries TLS versions, algorithms and other handshake fields, as the lesson itself explains.

sd-https-tls/test-a3: The solution says certificate copies drop from 30 to 3, "and so do renewals." Thirty deployments of the same certificate do not necessarily require thirty separate certificate renewals; renewal and deployment are different operations.
